theorem_export.claim: P2344 extends P2343 from the flat round D^4_R class to a genuinely non-round one-parameter flat spheroidal class D^4_q with boundary S^3_q and q>0.  Using the explicit Gauss-map Jacobian density J_q(theta)=(1/q)/(sin(theta)**2+cos(theta)**2/q**2)**2 and the substitution t=tan(theta), the integral of sigma3(K)dA reduces to (8*pi/q)*Integral_0^oo t**2/(t**2+1/q**2)**2 dt = 2*pi**2.  Therefore the declared Track-B boundary functional 16*Integral sigma3(K)dA remains 32*pi**2 with zero q-derivative and gives the same ledger pairing as P2341.
